title: Interministerial decree 29 February 2024 (Art. 2 – Definizioni)
notes: Defines highly qualified activity by reference to art. 27-quater D.Lgs. 286/1998, and nomade digitale (self-employed) vs lavoratore da remoto (employee/collaborator).

title: Interministerial decree 29 February 2024 (Art. 3 – Requisiti)
notes: Art. 3.1(a)-(d): income vs ticket-exemption minimum, health insurance, accommodation documentation, 6 months' prior experience; 3.1(e) refers to art. 27-quater. Remote-only items in separate row. Art. 3.1(e): contract or binding offer for remote workers; Art. 3.4-3.5: employer declaration of no convictions (art. 22 c.5-bis TU).

title: Interministerial decree 29 February 2024 (Art. 4 – Permesso di soggiorno)
notes: Apply at the Questura within 8 working days of entry; permesso 'nomade digitale - lavoratore da remoto' up to 1 year, renewable; show visa documentation stamped by the consulate; family reunification.

title: Interministerial decree 29 February 2024 (Art. 6 – Codice fiscale and partita IVA)
notes: Art. 6.1: codice fiscale generated and communicated by the Questura when the permesso is issued. Art. 6.2: digital nomads also request a partita IVA under art. 35 DPR 633/1972.

title: Consolidated immigration act D.Lgs. 286/1998 – art. 4 (Ingresso)
notes: Art. 4.1: entry requires a valid passport or equivalent travel document plus visa. States no minimum residual validity; validity periods come from consulate pages.
